_what_this_is: Hand adjudication of the study type of the 40-paper random sample drawn by draw_handcheck_sample.py (seed 20260908), performed from the committed title and journal only, BEFORE any within-stratum cue rate was computed. One reader (the lane agent); there is no second reader, which is a stated limitation. The reader knew each paper's EMC/other status because the disease name is in the title and cannot be blinded; the reader did NOT know any paper's cue count, because no cue field was read at any point before these labels were written.
_label_definitions: Identical to the pre-specified strata in genre_classifier.py. 'unclassified' is NOT available to the hand reader: a human can always assign a stratum, so every machine 'unclassified' counts as a disagreement. Hybrid case-report-plus-review papers are labelled case_report_or_series, matching the machine rule's S1-before-S2 precedence.
